The AB output pin first two digits/letters and wedge region are damaged; its surviving 5/open star and source route are preserved.
Hole cuts first header zero and RT7; surviving00 and51 remain. Full right vertical page identifier remains readable.

The first two printed pin glyphs and border/wedge cell are erased. Candidate B05 based on card and source context; surviving5 and open star remain. The physical output route and its diamond to AX R termination are clear.
Last portion glyph only has an upper arc. Candidate9 from A1; kept as replacement character.

White/creased loss removes the complete RT341AB4 reference, suffix of RS101AB4, four right input bit numbers and parts of four table pairs. Notes preserve exact replacement cells and original before/after scans RT747 and RT753.

Literal PFR is directly readable, with a top and middle bar but no bottom foot on F. Coordinator corrected the TIFF meaningful stem to PFR, with unchanged source bytes and original scan order; exact correction audit retained.
